title: Read offline scorer history
description: Read experiment summaries for a scorer definition UUID, grouped by experiment and exact scorer version. Defaults to completed experiments; select statuses explicitly to inspect partial runs. Filter by suite, dataset/revision, execution dates, application/model/prompt revisions, or scorer-version UUIDs to compare compatible cohorts. Never combine different versions merely because their names match. Returns count, next_cursor, and results.
